card.name: "seen" and "in" in clinical findings
card.fires_on: The word "seen" after "may be" or "are" when describing clinical findings in overdose or lab text. Also "in" inside trial names such as "Intervention in Metabolic Syndrome" and "Risk in Diabetes".

modes.label: seen after may be
modes.description: The word "seen" ends a passive phrase saying a sign may be seen or are seen.
modes.example: Bradycardia may be<< seen>> early in phenylephrine overdos

modes.label: in inside trial names
modes.description: The word "in" sits inside the name of a named cardiovascular clinical trial.
modes.example: The Atherothrombosis Intervention<< in>> Metabolic Syndrome

card.plain: It marks the word "seen" in phrases like "may be seen" and the word "in" in trial names.
